summary: Comprehensive architectural blueprint and implementation plan for KSU Infra & Logistic corporate website, featuring dual-vertical showcase (Logistics & Transport + Infra Projects & Construction), brand-authentic Indian infrastructure aesthetics (Navy Blue, Metallic Gold, Saffron), interactive quotation and WhatsApp workflow, interactive logistics calculator, responsive desktop and mobile UX with sticky contact triggers, Netlify form readiness, and SEO optimization.
